{{Quote|Okay Rescue Flight, the islands are clear. Proceed to docking bays.| [[Rhys Dallows|Bravo 10]] to Rescue Flight|<ref name="Starfighter" />}}
'''Rescue Flight''' was a group of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] that resisted the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|occupation]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Starfighter" />

==History==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Rescue Flight, led by [[Rescue Leader]], and [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] joined forces to [[Raid on the Solleu River|liberate civilians]] from a [[Trade Federation prison camp|Federation prison camp]] along the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]].<ref name="Starfighter" />

Bravo Flight’s [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] destroyed the camp’s defensive [[Turret droid]]s, allowing Rescue Flight’s [[Rescue Boat]]s [[Rescue 1 (Rescue Boat)|''Rescue 1'']], [[Rescue 2 (Rescue Boat)|''Rescue 2'']], and [[Rescue 3 (Rescue Boat)|''Rescue 3'']] to evacuate prisoners from three main prison buildings.<ref name="Starfighter" />

With the last prisoners secured, Rescue Flight transported them down the Solleu to the [[Europa Islands]], where the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mercatan]]'' awaited them.<ref name="Starfighter" />
